name: AWS Knowledge
description: AWS Knowledge lets agents search and read current AWS documentation, and check which services and features are available in each AWS Region. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: Is Amazon Bedrock available in eu-central-1?
What does the AWS documentation recommend for S3 bucket access control?
What are the default Lambda concurrency limits, and how do I raise them?

apps.name: AWS Knowledge
apps.description: AWS documentation search and regional availability, over the AWS Knowledge MCP server with no sign-in.
